notes.title: Patch Notes, Version 2.72 – 28 August, 2025
notes.content:
[h2]Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] You can polymorph to out-of-difficulty forms by chance if you have high luck.
[*] Monsters can polymoprh to out-of-difficulty forms by chance if you have low luck.
[*] Invisible pets can now steal from shops.
[*] Various bug fixes.
[/list]

There's no version 2.71 on Windows.
